pictures.name: CSH1-Field-Night
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Open hill fields outside Bethlehem at night, a low stone sheepfold, sheep sleeping in a huddle. In the middle, three shepherds: a weathered old man with a white beard and a sheepskin cloak, a strong middle-aged man in a striped brown wool cloak, and a lanky young man with a crook, sit around a small low campfire, wrapped in their cloaks, one yawning, one poking the embers, one watching the dark hills. Bethlehem’s few lamps glow on the far hill. Deep blue starry night, warm gold firelight. Weariness, ordinary night work. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CSH2-Angel-Appears
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The same hill field at night, suddenly flooded with light: a tall radiant pillar of white and gold light stands in the air above the sheepfold, no figure, no face, no wings, only brightness. Below, in the middle, three shepherds: a weathered old man with a white beard and a sheepskin cloak, a strong middle-aged man in a striped brown wool cloak, and a lanky young man with a crook, shield their eyes and fall back in terror, the young one dropping his crook, sheep startled. Brilliant gold light against the deep blue night. Awe, fear, glory. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CSH3-Good-News
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The same field, the pillar of white and gold light now closer and calmer, glowing softly, no figure, no face, no wings, a soft beam of its light stretching toward Bethlehem on the far hill. three shepherds: a weathered old man with a white beard and a sheepskin cloak, a strong middle-aged man in a striped brown wool cloak, and a lanky young man with a crook, kneel, faces lifting from fear to wonder, the old man’s hands open. Warm gold heavenly light, deep blue night. Joy dawning, good news. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CSH4-Sky-Full
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The night sky over the fields of Bethlehem filled from edge to edge with countless soft streams and points of white and gold light, a singing host made only of light, no figures, no faces, no wings, the light streaming down. Far below, small in the middle of the picture, three shepherds: a weathered old man with a white beard and a sheepskin cloak, a strong middle-aged man in a striped brown wool cloak, and a lanky young man with a crook, stand gazing up, arms raised, the sheep around them. Brilliant gold light pouring into the deep blue sky. Glory, music, overwhelming joy. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CSH5-Shepherds-Kneel
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The lower room of a stone house in Bethlehem at night, an ox and a donkey, straw, a stone manger. Mary, a young woman with dark hair under a soft blue veil, sits beside the manger where a newborn baby wrapped snugly in plain cream cloth, turned away from the viewer, his face hidden in the folds of the cloth and never visible, a soft glow of light around him, lies in hay; Joseph, a man with a short dark beard in a brown tunic, holds a lamp. three shepherds: a weathered old man with a white beard and a sheepskin cloak, a strong middle-aged man in a striped brown wool cloak, and a lanky young man with a crook, kneel just inside the doorway, the young one with a lamb in his arms, faces full of wonder. Warm gold lamplight, deep blue night through the door. Humility, awe, joy. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CSH6-Tell-Everyone
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A narrow lane in Bethlehem at dawn: three shepherds: a weathered old man with a white beard and a sheepskin cloak, a strong middle-aged man in a striped brown wool cloak, and a lanky young man with a crook, hurry through the street waving their arms, telling astonished townspeople who lean out of doorways and windows. In the foreground, framed in a lamp-lit doorway, Mary, a young woman with dark hair under a soft blue veil, holds a newborn baby wrapped snugly in plain cream cloth, turned away from the viewer, his face hidden in the folds of the cloth and never visible, a soft glow of light around him, close against her shoulder and looks down thoughtfully, quietly pondering. Gold dawn light, deep blue shadows. Joy and quiet wonder together. No text, no letters, no logos.
